name: restate
description: Check interpretation, ambiguity, problem diagnosis, and solution quality before execution.

interface.longDescription: Restate provides independent checks for interpretation, material ambiguity, XY problems, and solution quality, plus a Clarify interview with persistent decision items, visible round progress, and contextual review.
defaultPrompt: Find material ambiguity in this request
Check whether this solves the actual problem
Re-weigh this plan for a more elegant path
Run a tracked requirements interview with restate:clarify
